sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
templatePurpose: Define the minimum redacted evidence slots required before NHATS registration, permitted user boundary, file access tier and controlled workspace evidence may unlock any data download, extraction script, calibration or model-admission step.

currentDecision.reason: The registration evidence template is ready, but no NHATS account status, permitted user boundary, conditions attestation, file-tier approval, controlled workspace evidence, second review, data download, extraction, calibration or individual prediction is available.

evidenceSlots.requiredEvidence: NHATS registration completed by an eligible user, with account identity and any private proof stored outside the public repository.
Permitted user, organization, sharing boundary and role limitations reviewed against NHATS conditions.
Reviewer attests current NHATS/NSOC Conditions of Use, including no public AI upload and no unauthorized sharing.
For every planned public-use file, record registration-required status, DOI/page source, canonical format and allowed controlled local path.
Sensitive and restricted files are either excluded or have file-specific approval evidence recorded outside the public repository.
Non-repository controlled workspace, access log path, inventory log path and destruction process are provisioned before download.
Explicit check that credentials, cookies, tokens, private account data, row-level records and raw files are absent from repository, issues, web output and public AI tools.
Second reviewer confirms registration evidence, storage boundary, file-tier status and prohibited-use boundary before any extraction script exists.

blockedUntil: registered account status is confirmed outside the public repository
permitted user and sharing boundary are reviewed
current Conditions of Use are attested
public-use, sensitive and restricted file tiers are recorded
controlled workspace, inventory log and access log are provisioned outside the repository
repository and public AI no-secret/no-raw-data check passes
prohibitedActions: Do not download NHATS or NSOC files from this template.
Do not create real extraction scripts until registration, file tiers, variables, survey design, disclosure control and storage gates pass.
Do not store account identity details, credentials, cookies, tokens or private registration proof in this repository.
Do not store raw NHATS, raw NSOC, row-level derivatives or small-cell sensitive outputs in this repository.
Do not upload NHATS, NSOC, registration artifacts, authenticated pages, row-level data or raw files to public AI systems.
Do not enable calibration, L4 model admission, individual prediction or personal advice from registration-template evidence.
